title: Omnicorp Holdings Rumored to Be Mining Crypto on Hartwell Building's Missing 13th Floor
body: Anonymous sources claim the "missing" floor 13 houses 847 ASIC miners. Omnicorp denies the building even has a 13th floor, which is technically true.
summary: The Hartwell Building's missing floor may be hiding a crypto mining operation.

comments.content: I work at Hartwell Building maintenance. The 13th floor EXISTS. I've seen the mining rigs. Omnicorp pays us to stay quiet. Buy HUSK before the truth comes out.
